verdict.rationale: MX documents a ready-made, embeddable Connect Widget that prompts end users to connect to their financial institutions, so developers don't build institution UI. It is used together with the Platform API and ships official Web and React Native SDKs, with guidance on handling OAuth in WebViews. The evidence does not explicitly show the server-side widget-session creation call, or what the widget hands back when a user connects an account. missing for 10: documented server-side session/widget-URL creation step, documented post-connection callback returning a member/account identifier, independent hands-on corroboration.
